messages:
Mira Chen: hey all :wave: first day here — quick question: where should I post about getting a door badge and VPN access? SSO keeps redirecting me to an empty page.

Jon Patel: welcome Mira! badge requests go to people-ops (DM @People Ops) or fill the form in the handbook. VPN/SSO issues we usually track in #help or open a ticket with IT Ops. can you paste the exact error?

Mira Chen: thanks! error shows "SAML response missing assertion" after I sign in with Okta. tried chrome and safari.

OnboardBot: :robot_face: Hi Mira! I created your onboarding checklist (https://intranet.redwood.com/onboarding/1719623456). Next steps: 1) join #new-hires 2) run `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "mira@redwood.com"` and add to https://git.redwood.com/profile/keys 3) request badge via People Ops form. Reply here when done and we'll mark items off.

IT Ops: Mira — sorry about that SAML error. quick workaround: clear Okta cookies, then try an incognito window. if it still fails, please run this and paste output: ``curl -I https://console.redwood.com/auth/okta`` also tagging @People Ops for badge flow.

Jon Patel: small etiquette / channel tips for first week: use threads to follow up so #new-hires stays scannable; DM people for 1:1 access creds; post infra stuff in #help or #eng-infra, hardware/travel in #people-ops, and product questions in #product. reactions are fine to ack. :thumbsup:

Sam Nguyen: also subscribe to the onboarding bots: `/subscribe OnboardBot` and the calendar bot for standups. if you want low-noise, mute channels you don't need and pin the onboarding checklist message.

Mira Chen: copying the curl output now, and I'll open a ticket if incognito doesn't work. thanks for the tips — will subscribe to bots and move followups into a thread. :grin:
